question: Which of the following leagues is related to the game of football?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Super League**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Super League** is a professional football league in India.
 
• It was founded in 2013 with the aim of growing the sport of football in India and increasing its exposure.
 
• The league operates on a franchise system, similar to the Indian Premier League in cricket.</l
